posts.name: TheTroll
posts.cooked: Hello all, I thought I would introduce myself. I am The Troll and I got into this when a friend wanted stuff for Shadowrun and asked me what bribes I would accept. The base set along with the infernal relics and rook city expansions were part of my bribe and I'm very pleased with it so far. Haven't had too much time for my friends to join me, but I have gotten a few games with them and some solo in.
